lines: I know it's meaningless to try and catch up on sleep.
My life is just idly scrolling through other people's dances.
I try to appease others with formalities, but it's just a monotonous failure.
Wrapped up in laziness, I play a game focused on logic.
Shiney likea ginger, I get intoxicated, including with ale.
I end up dancing at the peak, a reply-holic.
The streetlight's light illuminates my pain.
I celebrate someone else's happiness, while secretly envying it.
My impatience has spilled over.
And yet, as bright as the sunlight is,
My body feels heavy and sluggish.
Even if I dance to these common, imitation emotions,
I am still nobody.
But it's too late for me to back down now.
“When everyone is asleep, it's my turn to appear.”
I'll dance through the night to a dull rhythm.
Even my hippocampus is covered in ash.
Who could possibly claim to understand me?
Night is mercy, my lungs cry out, I am ruined.
I breathe on the internet, opening and closing.
Advice from someone whose face I can't even see is worthless.
These fleeting encounters, a courtesy where we can't connect.
Following orders just hurts me, and eventually I'll rot away.
Ah, what brilliant, sparkling stars.
Let's breathe in and out, and exchange favors, shall we?

But it's too late for me to back down now.

Night is mercy, my lungs cry out, I pray.
My stance is gradually becoming sloppy.
Dance, dance, the steps are complex.
They've been haphazardly etched into me.

Only misery shielded the night.

“Funeral. When everyone is asleep, it's my turn to appear.”

Even my hippocampus is covered in ash.
Who could possibly claim to understand me?
Night is mercy, my lungs cry out.
I'll out-dance them with my dull style.
I only smelled my hippocampus.
Who could possibly claim to understand me by solving past problems?
Only Gaia's brain is high at dawn.
